name: Running Souls
summary: The end of the world is coming, everyone and everything is running for their life. You have one soul, but this soul is special, this soul can move from one organism to another and even to any object in the world. Once your soul move to other element, you get the power of the element. You can start from being a human, move your soul to a bag of plastic, move it to a car, move to a bird, etc. Just keep running for you life and you'll be saved!
